cases.sentence: Над ___ пусть они расстелют голубое покрывало, покроют его кожей дюгоней и вложат шесты.
cases.explain: «золотым жертвенником» — after the preposition «над», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

cases.sentence: Им нельзя прикасаться к самим ___, иначе они умрут.
cases.explain: «священным вещам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

cases.sentence: Пусть Элеазар, сын священника Аарона, заботится о масле для посвящения, кадильном благовонии, постоянном ___ и масле для помазания.
cases.explain: «хлебном приношении» — the prepositional is used only after a preposition, for location or topic.
cases.translation: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

cases.sentence: Чтобы они жили и не умерли, приближаясь к ___, сделайте для них вот что: пусть Аарон и его сыновья входят в святилище и назначают каждому его службу и что ему нести.
cases.explain: «великим святыням» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

cases.sentence: Вся их служба, переноска или ___, пусть совершается под руководством Аарона и его сыновей.
cases.explain: «другая работа» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

cases.explain: «гершонитских кланов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

cases.sentence: Такова служба ___, которую они должны исполнять при шатре собрания под началом Итамара, сына священника Аарона.
cases.explain: «мераритских кланов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

cases.sentence: Это ___ всех, кто в каафитских кланах служил при шатре собрания.
cases.explain: «общее число» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

cases.sentence: Это ___ всех, кто в гершонитских кланах служил при шатре собрания.
cases.explain: «общее число» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh.

cases.explain: «общее число» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
